remarks: Nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac lane, this beautiful farmhouse colonial offers the perfect blend of luxury and convenience. 14 Partridge Lane is just a 7-minute walk from downtown Darien and the train station, and a 5 minute walk from scenic Tilley Pond - a year-round destination for peaceful walks, ice skating in winter, and relaxing outdoor moments - location is everything and this home has it all.  Set on over half an acre, the house is bathed in natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere throughout. The chef's kitchen seamlessly opens to the family room, making it ideal for both family gatherings and entertaining. A wood-burning fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and sky light add to the room's warmth and charm. Don't miss the sliders to a private back patio perfect for al fresco dining and relaxation. There is stunning great room, with soaring ceilings, shiplap detail throughout, a wall of windows, and another cozy fireplace. This room leads to a beautiful screened-in porch, where you can unwind while enjoying the peaceful surroundings.   With multiple outdoor spaces to entertain and relax, this home offers exceptional opportunities for both indoor and outdoor living.   Close to everything - shops, dining, schools, and transportation - it's a commuter's dream with easy access to all that Darien has to offer.  Make this stunning property your forever home!
